results.title: Feature.fm is rated "Poor" with 2.5 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
## After trying multiple marketing…
After trying multiple marketing platforms for music i gave FFM a shot.  
They are pretty expensive but have a lot of unique features.   
However everything on their website is pretty hard to find & understand and there arent any tutorials. A lot of features you really have to know the platform inside out.  
  
In my free trial i got emailed by the customer satisfaction team if i have any questions, i sent them a long email with all my questions. But of course they only respond when the trial is over.  
I arranged to have a call with one of the employees, great.  
In the call they promised me all kinds of things. [...] In conclusion, until Feature.fm can demonstrate a significant improvement in the professionalism of their representatives and interactions, I strongly advise others to avoid engaging with them. Trust is paramount in business, and after this interaction, trust is the last word that comes to mind when I think of Feature.fm. [...] ## Review of Feature.fm: An Alarming and Unprofessional Experience
My recent experience with Feature.fm through an individual claiming to be "Roxana" has left me thoroughly unimpressed and deeply concerned. Feature.fm, a platform supposedly built to facilitate digital music promotion, seems to operate in an atmosphere of questionable professionalism, if this encounter is any indication.
